prompt:

Eleven icons ONLY in slots 1 through 11, slots 12 through 16 completely empty transparent. Each icon entirely contained within the central 65% of its own equal cell, generous empty transparent gutters on all sides. Do NOT expand the last row or reflow the grid. Crisp original hand-painted classic fantasy inventory art with realistic forged metal, cloth, leather, faceted gems; upper-left highlights, strong silhouettes readable at 36px. Similar visual family to original dark fantasy loot icons, no commercial game copies. NO text, numbers, labels, letters, border, square frames, UI, background, checkerboard, character, mannequin or watermark. Names are semantic art direction, never render text.
